name: week
title: Utility service week
subtitle: Decisions from recorded commercial account data

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select * from v_attention order by kind,reference

sections.title: Response queue
sections.sql: select source_id,subject,account,owner,due_on,days_overdue from v_case_queue order by due_on

name: renewals
title: Agreement review
subtitle: Dates and coverage, not a switching instruction

sections.title: Notice windows
sections.sql: select agreement,account,site,end_on,notice_on,days_left from v_renewals order by end_on

name: readings
title: Meter reading review
subtitle: Cumulative register history; estimated intervals are not settled usage

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.sql: select meter,site,unit,read_on,per_day,issue from v_reading_exceptions order by meter

sections.title: History
sections.sql: select meter,site,read_on,kind,unit,consumption,per_day from v_usage order by meter,read_on
